ov: Large, long-tailed and often colourful New World parrots in six genera. They’re popular as companion birds, though several wild species are of conservation concern.

why.p: Macaws are popular companion parrots, though several species are threatened in the wild.

rg: Mexico, Central America and South America; formerly the Caribbean.
df: Seeds, nuts, fruits, leaves, flowers and shoots.
fx: Macaws have a large bare patch of pale skin on the face.
notes: Group entry. The existing fact is confirmed, with a hedge: "it has been suggested" macaws eat clay from river banks to neutralise toxins in their food.
